payload.title: Plasmid Miniprep (Alkaline Lysis)
payload.description: {"blocks":[{"key":"a1","text":"Standard alkaline-lysis plasmid miniprep for purifying plasmid DNA from overnight E. coli cultures.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

steps.step: {"blocks":[{"key":"s1","text":"Pellet 5 mL of overnight culture by centrifugation at 8000 x g for 3 min.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"s2","text":"Resuspend the pellet in 250 uL P1 buffer by vortexing.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"s3","text":"Add 250 uL P2 buffer and mix gently by inverting 6 times.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"s4","text":"Add 350 uL P3 buffer and mix immediately; incubate on ice for 5 min.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"s5","text":"Centrifuge at 13000 x g for 10 min and load the supernatant onto a spin column.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"s6","text":"Wash the column once and elute in 50 uL elution buffer.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
